strategies
 
below
 
are
 
designed
 
to
 
optimize
 
our
 
current
 
inventory

are
 
introducing

combines

Backpack

Wireless
 
Earbuds
 
(RAF-TWS-01)
 
for
 
fitness
 
enthusiasts.
  
2.  Exclusive  VIP  Campaign  
We  currently  hold  exactly  60  units  of  the  Rafita  Smart  Home  Hub  (RAF-HUB-01) .  Instead  of  a  
general
 
release,
 
we
 
will
 
position
 
this
 
as
 
an
 
ultra-premium
 
item.
 ●  Channel:  Email  Marketing.  ●  Target:  Top  100  members  of  the  "Rafita  Closer"  loyalty  program.  ●  Offer:  Early  access  to  the  Smart  Home  Hub  before  public  release.   
3.  Channel  Allocation  &  Budget  Focus  
Based  on  our  past  performance,  we  will  allocate  our  marketing  budget  for  these  bundles  as  
follows:
 
Bundle  Name  Primary  Marketing  Channel  Target  Demographic  
  
The  WFH  Pro  Kit  Google  Ads  (Search)  Professionals,  Tech  Enthusiasts  
The  Urban  Commuter  TikTok  &  Instagram  Ads  Students,  Millennials  
 
4.  Logistics  &  Supply  Chain  Integration  
Order  fulfillment  for  Eastern  Indonesia  will  be  prioritized  through  the  new  Makassar  logistics  
hub.
 
The
 
Urban
 
Commuter
 
bundle
 
will
 
have
 
30%
 
of
 
its
 
dedicated
 
stock
 
pre-positioned
 
at
 
the
 
Makassar
 
hub
 
by
 
August
 
2026
 
to
 
ensure
 
fast
 
delivery.

Based  on  Q1  performance  analysis  results,  here  are  the  strategic  focuses  for  the  next  quarter:  1.  Increase  budget  allocation  for  Search  Engine  Marketing  by  20%  to  maximize  high  ROI
